title: Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector
function: Robot end-effector vacuum pad for wafer handling
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector because its non-magnetic permeability (µ <1.0001) eliminates interference with electron beam trajectories in vacuum processing chambers. The low sputter yield of Ti (0.3 atoms/ion at 500eV Ar+) compared to Al (1.2) reduces cross-contamination in thin-film deposition tools. Matched thermal expansion (8.6 µm/m°C) with ceramic end-effectors prevents particle generation during thermal cycling — critical for Robot end-effector vacuum pad for wafer handling. This rationale is driven by robot end-effector vacuum pad for wafer handling and fat life requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for wafer handling geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse at 200W fiber laser
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for robot endeffector vacuum application
commonFailures: Virtual leak from dead-leg threaded connections - remedied by VCR/Swagelok face-seal fittings — critical for robot endeffector vacuum performance

faq.q: What is the magnetic permeability of Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V has a magnetic permeability µ < 1.0001 (effectively non-magnetic), essential for robot endeffector vacuum in electron beam lithography, ion implantation, and SEM/EDX tool chambers where magnetic materials would deflect charged particle beams. Permeability is verified per ASTM A342 for each production batch.

faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector?
faq.a: Each Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for robot endeffector vacuum.
